roadmap.title: Story + the one missable meditation
roadmap.text: Play Chapters 1–5 (60–80 hours). The 12 story trophies pop automatically, including the gold for the final mission. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the moment it appears — it is the only thing in the game that can be missed. Keep a manual save from before the mission Down to Earth. Also grab the easy story-adjacent trophies that open along the way: the UFO abduction after Chapter 1 (The Truth Is Out There) and the Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar (In The Beginning…).
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

roadmap.title: Stranger questlines
roadmap.text: Finish the six stranger questlines with their own trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and the eight counted strands for Strangers & Freaks. Kirk's Skunk Ape strand, Kyle's farm, Yago's racing and Pilot Pete's deliveries are the confirmed counters — many other questlines do not count toward the eight, so do not assume.

roadmap.title: Partner crimes
roadmap.text: With your partner along, do the duo crime trophies: lose a 4-star wanted level together (Hot Together), rob three shops back-to-back (Retail Therapy), and the solo crime set — Gunslinger, the VCIA plane theft, the Rhino tank, the Payday Loans re-robbery (Bad Luck, I Guess) and the 500 Criminal Profile actions. Watch the Irredeemable warning: sustained extreme violence is permanent.

roadmap.title: Activities & racing
roadmap.text: Work the activity trophies: 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone-race locations, 20 race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, one finished arcade game, and maximum Strength with both characters at once (Personal Best). Raise Focus early — it makes The Shootist and Gunslinger far easier.

roadmap.title: Collecting & scanning
roadmap.text: Sweep the collections: 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 100 vehicles scanned, 18 meditation spots (both characters at each spot), and clearing the map fog for The Goodtime State. Most of this happens naturally if you scan everything you pass from the start.

roadmap.title: Robberies & fencing
roadmap.text: The money stage: 5 bank vaults, the armored-truck robbery, one illegal operation per gang, the showroom Banshee smash (Capital Offense), the Kingpin Bowling valuables, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages bought and 10 vehicles registered. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each — they fund everything else in this stage.

roadmap.title: 100% checklist cleanup → Platinum
roadmap.text: Finish the 100% completion checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion): 50 of 80 challenges, the remaining card sets, stunt and drone totals, underwater discoveries and the rest. A Long Road pops here, and with it the platinum — Vice Got a Price!. Total platinum time is commonly estimated at 200–300 hours.

missable_grid.notes: Positive Mental Attitude: the balcony meditation after Down to Earth. Do it when it appears; keep a save from before the mission.
No missable trophies. Coffee Break opens duo free-roam and the partner crime trophies.
No missable trophies. Key Cloner, Dye Pack Jammer and the stranger questlines open here.
No missable trophies. Bank-vault robberies open with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
No missable trophies. After the credits, free-roam opens and everything unfinished can be done.
Every trophy except the Chapter 1 meditation can be finished here. Optional missions expire over time but do not affect trophies or 100%.

save_strategy.text: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so manual saves are your only safety net. You get 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave.
tips: Save manually at the start and the end of every chapter (10 saves).
Rotate the remaining 5 slots during free-roam cleanup — never overwrite your chapter saves.
Keep a save from before the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth until Positive Mental Attitude pops.
Do not rely on the autosave in the prologue: it does not always trigger, and the save menu does not show it — use the load menu.
Save before trying anything disputed or risky, like the Apollo Aggregates glitch or the Capri ritual.

warnings.title: Cheats disable trophies — and saving
warnings.text: Using any cheat disables trophies and saving for that session. Cheats only appear in the Progress menu after all story missions are finished. Never use cheats on your platinum save.

warnings.title: Criminal Profile Irredeemable is permanent
warnings.text: Sustained extreme violence pushes your Criminal Profile to Irredeemable, and it never goes back — police become far more aggressive and shoot on sight. The other profiles (Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho) are not permanent.

warnings.title: No mission replay
warnings.text: A missed story moment cannot be replayed. Chapter saves are the only way back — see the save strategy above.

warnings.title: A Classic Blitz Play can fail to pop
warnings.text: Robbing an armored truck directly is reported to fail the trophy. Use the bank-vault route from the Chapter 4 mission instead.

warnings.title: 0 trophies are glitched
warnings.text: PowerPyx reports no glitched trophies: every trophy can pop. The only reported failure is the A Classic Blitz Play truck bug above.

overlap100.summary: Working toward 100% completion finishes many trophies for free: A Long Road itself, Cunning Stunts (250 of the 300 needed), The Shootist (42 = 42), Top Fun, Earn Cash (20 of 30), Master of None, Whip It Good (100 of 200), One Last Thing (50 of 70), Don't Touch My Deck (3 of 15), You WAiNKer! (100 = 100), Maximum Withdrawal (5 of 8), A Classic Blitz Play, Dime on the Dollar ($250,000 = $250,000) and Hot Together (automatic during vault robberies). Partly covered: Positive Mental Attitude (15 of 18 for 100%, trophy needs 18), Pest Control (1 per gang of 39), Stick Fiddler and Fair Game. Everything else — all 12 story trophies, the stranger finals, and most crime and misc trophies — must be done separately from the 100% checklist.

disagreements.title: Personal Best — story trophy or Strength?
disagreements.text: ofzenandcomputing calls it a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. PowerPyx and most other sources say it needs maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. This guide follows PowerPyx.

disagreements.title: Bad Luck, I Guess — Chapter 2 or Chapter 3?
disagreements.text: PowerPyx says it is possible from Chapter 2, once you can play as Lucia. damnmodz lists getting the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3 as the best lead. Try Chapter 2 first.

disagreements.title: Apollo Aggregates money glitch — works or not?
disagreements.text: KeeNgamer and allblogthings (20 Nov) say the save/reload loot respawn works at launch. afleurdenet and vanotherlevel (18–20 Nov) say no working infinite-money glitch exists yet, and most money-glitch videos are fake or phishing. Shown as REPORTED, not fact.

disagreements.title: Chapter 1 meditation — required for Positive Mental Attitude?
disagreements.text: The balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot. It is not confirmed whether it is required. PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it — do it anyway.

disagreements.title: A Classic Blitz Play — fast way or safe way?
disagreements.text: Robbing an armored truck directly is faster, but damnmodz reports it can fail to pop the trophy. The bank-vault route from the Chapter 4 mission is slower and safe.

disagreements.title: How long is the platinum — 200 or 300 hours?
disagreements.text: PowerPyx estimates around 200 hours; PushSquare estimates around 300 hours. The story alone is 60–80 hours. Your cleanup speed decides it.

disagreements.title: 100% completion — how complete is it really?
disagreements.text: PowerPyx notes the checklist is roughly 60% true completion — the in-game 100% does not mean literally everything in Leonida is done.

disagreements.title: Ten Pin — solved or not?
disagreements.text: Every guide agrees on the best lead (melee drive-by kick from a motorcycle) and no guide has proven the exact steps. This guide shows it as unknown rather than inventing steps.

disagreements.title: The Truth Is Out There — UFO or Capri ritual?
disagreements.text: PowerPyx and GameSpot say the UFO abduction triggers it. TechTudo (via Cut.pro) claims the Capri satanic ritual does. Both cannot be right for one trophy; this guide follows the UFO route.

disagreements.title: Alien-lab keypad code — 2134, 2314 or 2341?
disagreements.text: PowerPyx and YouTube walkthroughs say 2134, read from the dream after the abduction. OutputLag says try 2314, then 2341 — 'neither code works in every save'. Read the code from your own dream instead of trusting one number.

disagreements.title: Story length — 50–60 or 60–80 hours?
disagreements.text: Reviewers report 50–60 hours for the story; PowerPyx estimates 60–80 hours. The gap is play style and side content done along the way.

apollo.text: The red warehouse at Apollo Aggregates, east of Hamlet (South Vice-Dale County, north of Key Lento). Loot the cocaine from the back-office desk and the safe, fill two stash bags (one from the open van in the middle, one from another van), store BOTH bags in your personal vehicle's trunk, save the game in a separate manual slot, then load that save — the warehouse loot respawns while the trunk keeps what you stored. Repeat, and sell at Brian's Lockup, south-west of Key Lento (keypad code 7700). Reported yield is about $8,640 per loop, $11,000–$11,280 on the first loop. Never leave bags on the ground or carry them during the reload — they can vanish. Best from Chapter 2, since much Chapter 1 money is lost in the story transition.
steps: Enter the red Apollo Aggregates warehouse and loot the back office (desk cocaine + safe).
Fill two stash bags and store BOTH in your personal vehicle's trunk.
Save in a separate manual slot, then load that save — the loot respawns.
Repeat the loop, then sell at Brian's Lockup (keypad 7700).

legit.text: The reliable money route needs no glitch: large bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each (8 total), fencing pays best through Randy's Wish List cars, and Chapter 3–4 robberies are high value. Vault money covers the $160,000 garages and the $100,000 shopping trophy with room to spare.
items: Bank vaults: up to $205,000 per bank, 8 large bank jobs total.
Randy's Wish List: stolen sports cars fenced for top prices; condition matters.
Payday Loans jobs (7) and bank jobs (22) all pay toward the 100% checklist too.

tricks: Focus farm: loop the shooting range in 5-second runs to raise Focus fast (helps Gunslinger and The Shootist).
Train tunnel escape: the rail tunnel north of Ambrosia — police struggle to follow on the rails and helicopters cannot see you. Best for Hot Together and any 4-star escape.
Scan from busy streets: stand on a busy road and WAiNK-scan every vehicle that passes — Whip It Good and the 200 scans for 100% finish naturally.
Double meditation: meditate as Jason AND Lucia at the same spot for +2 (saves half the trips).
Double workout: work out with your partner along — both characters gain Strength (Personal Best).
Adrenaline stretches Combat Focus: take Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) before triggering Focus for Gunslinger.

First-gun discount: in the Chapter 1 weapon mission, clerk Andrew gives a 50% discount on the Fortune & Son Moreland 850 shotgun ($350 instead of $700) because Jason is ex-military — and the discount stays if you return later.
Pay 'n' Spray only cleans the CAR: it removes the car from the police description, not your clothes or face. Losing stars does not mean you are clean.
Clothes and hair are camouflage: changing outfit or hairstyle changes the description police have of you.

items.title: Day-one patches, no notes
items.text: Two pre-release updates arrived with no patch notes from Rockstar: v01.002.000 (13 Nov, ~1.07 GB PS5 / 2.18 GB Xbox) and v01.002.001 (16 Nov, ~602.5 MB PS5 / 1.6 GB Xbox). Both must be installed before playing.

items.title: PSN outage, 18 Nov
items.text: Hours before unlock, PSN login and downloads failed — about 10,000 reports in the US and 6,000 in the UK. Fixed by Wednesday afternoon. A Sony-side problem, not a game bug.

items.title: 0 glitched trophies
items.text: PowerPyx reports no trophy that cannot pop. The only trophy-adjacent bug is the A Classic Blitz Play truck report (see the Warnings).

items.title: No verified in-game bug list
items.text: As of 18–20 Nov, no outlet had published a verified list of in-game bugs. The game is widely rated very polished for its size (Metacritic 99). Player clips do show real bugs — see the Bugs section — but Rockstar has published no known-issues list.

items.title: Rumor: Rockstar apology + fix on 25 Nov
items.text: A viral X post claims Rockstar apologised and will fix things on 25 Nov. There is no support for it on any official Rockstar channel. Treat it as unverified.

items.title: Frame-rate drops
items.text: Target is 30 FPS; it drops in dense areas and while driving, on all consoles including PS5 Pro. There is no 60 FPS mode.

items.title: Boxed copies without a code
items.text: Some physical copies shipped without a download code, or with a code that could not be redeemed or was already used (reports since 13 Nov; some buyers got replacements).
